decisions.reason: As a recent extension of the established spraying business, its technical and market uncertainty is still resolving and the likely carrying cost is modest, so the option value of keeping it exceeds the case for withdrawal.

Because it is very close to the firm’s core offer and was given its own page, management would likely see it as a low-risk adjacent product whose prospects should be tested longer rather than abandoned quickly.

A new product line with several models suggests a broader platform commitment in a familiar domain, so despite some uncertainty the firm is likely to preserve this option and exploit synergies with its existing pump and transfer business.

Although somewhat more exploratory, it fits the firm’s move toward future-oriented and more digitalized customer solutions, and with industry growth and internal R&D capabilities management would likely keep it on the market while learning accumulates.
